# axm auth token

Output current auth token to stdout

## When to use

Output current auth token to stdout

## Usage

```bash
axm auth token <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Print your auth token (e.g., for piping to another tool)**

```bash
axm auth token
```

**Same command via shortcut**

```bash
axm token
```

**Get the token as structured JSON**

```bash
axm auth token --json
```

## Subcommands

| Command                               | Summary                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [axm auth token create](token/create) | Create a granular access token |
| [axm auth token list](token/list)     | List granular access tokens    |
| [axm auth token revoke](token/revoke) | Revoke a granular access token |

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
